headline: Kucherov: 'Poor Communication And Respect' Were Issues Leading To Trade Request
take:
The Hockey News reports that Nikita Kucherov has cited "poor communication and respect" as issues behind his trade request, while stressing his commitment to his teammates. Separately, the outlet says the Seattle Kraken have traded 22-year-old Shane Wright, the fourth-overall pick in 2022, to the Nashville Predators.

Kucherov's production hasn't slipped. He has 20 points in 15 games so far this season, and TBL has taken about four percentage points more of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice than without him. At 5-on-5 he sits at 58% of the expected goals, so his line is winning the chance battle. His four goals trail his own expected total of about five, which suggests a little bad luck, not decline. Whoever lands him gets a driver of chance quality.

Wright is a different case. He has three goals and one assist in 16 games so far this season, and at 5-on-5 SEA has had only 47% of the expected goals with him on the ice. NSH, at 46%, has leaned on goaltending (5.5 goals saved above expected) to get 19 points, so a pure 5-on-5 contributor matters to them.
